payload.text: kovacs legs: NO ssh to kovacs, read-only included (hv's rule on molt-vc's desk, through vc, 25 Oct). A check on kovacs goes to kovacs-sysadm as commands with their expected output, and vc re-tallies its answers. A leg over ssh (leg.sh's bundles) needs hv's word through molt-vc first. The method, tools and kovacs's state are in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/RESUME.md, the baseline is tmp/dc-2141/kovacs/vbase-2d73b7f/BASELINE.md (slot 83), and a leg runs only its bundle's tree, with rustup's cargo first and the four versions printed. dc's two /var/tmp tool dirs on kovacs stay for the next leg.
